# Bonjour !

Welcome to my personal page. I currently work as a PhD candidate in Economics at the [Center for Studies and Research on International Development](https://cerdi.uca.fr/english-version#/admin) (CERDI), in Clermont-Ferrand, France. My work is supported by the partnership between the [Foundation for Studies and Research on International Development](https://ferdi.fr/en/ferdi) (FERDI) and the Banque de France.

I study the distribution of international public (concessional) finance, *aka* foreign aid, in response to climate-related risks in low- and middle-income countries. My research covers topics at the intersection of political economy, climate change adaptation, and disaster risk reduction.

More broadly, I find that reading other people's writings helps me cope with the existential anxiety that comes from being alive on this Earth. Their words help me understand what it might entail to lead a joyful existence collectively on a warming planet. Social ties, food, physical activity, and music also help.

Please get in touch if any of this resonates with you!
